_readme: Canned sample receipts for the sample-picker flow. No OCR is run on these. Each sample is designed to deterministically surface at least one Overpriced item and at least one Subscription/Fee Trap so the demo never falls flat. Amounts are in INR and illustrative.

samples.blurb: Everyday groceries with a padded salt price and a sneaky bag charge.
